title: Number Of Ways To Arrive At Destination
description:
An undirected connected graph has positive travel times on its roads, with at most one road between any pair of intersections. Return the number of distinct routes from intersection 0 to intersection `n - 1` whose total travel time is minimum, modulo `10^9 + 7`.

## Examples

```text
Input: n = 7, roads = [[0, 6, 7], [0, 1, 2], [1, 2, 3], [1, 3, 3], [6, 3, 3], [3, 5, 1], [6, 5, 1], [2, 5, 1], [0, 4, 5], [4, 6, 2]]
Output: 4
```

```text
Input: n = 2, roads = [[1, 0, 10]]
Output: 1
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= n <= 200`
- `n - 1 <= roads.length <= n * (n - 1) / 2`
- Each road is `[u, v, time]`, with `0 <= u, v < n`, `u != v`, and `1 <= time <= 10^9`.
- The graph is connected and has no parallel roads.
